theme_archetype.rationale: For a mobility/taxi app in Mali, maximum readability under harsh sunlight is paramount. Swiss Brutalism provides functional clarity, while a high-contrast stark palette (Black, White, Signal Yellow) signals authority and speed, breaking away from the generic 'Uber black/white' or 'Fintech blue' norms.

rules: Overlines MUST be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Radical weight contrast: pair font-black headings with font-light or regular body text.

surfaces.general: Neo-Brutalist utility. Flat solid backgrounds with 1px solid black borders. NO soft shadows. Use hard drop shadows for elevation (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]).
surfaces.app_bottom_sheets: Stark white, 1px black top border, square corners (rounded-none).

spacing_and_layout.general_spacing: Generous scaling. p-6 or p-8 inside bordered containers.
spacing_and_layout.admin_dashboard: Control Room Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Tight gap-4. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
spacing_and_layout.passenger_driver_app: Map is the hero (full bleed). Interaction happens via bottom sheets/drawers and floating action buttons. floating elements must have high-contrast hard shadows.

components.general: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for layouts. Shadcn for interactive logic (Forms, Drawers, Dialogs).
components.overrides: Strip default Vercel border radii. Force rounded-none or max rounded-sm on all Shadcn components. Override default muted grays with pure high-contrast black/white.
components.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for bold, technical iconography. Ensure to install via yarn.
components.maps: Integrate real-time maps. Map UI components should float over the map using 'Crystal Glass' if scrolled under, or Solid Pure White with black borders.

motion.interactions: Snappy, fast micro-interactions. Zero lag for the driver app.
motion.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. Example: hover:bg-black hover:text-white transition-colors duration-200.

hero_graphic.context: Main visual for marketing landing page.

city_map_bg.context: Abstract background texture for login/auth screens or admin header.

driver_app_promo.context: Feature highlight for the Driver earnings & navigation showcase.

local_context_bamako.context: Passenger onboarding or location context graphic.

driver_portrait_2.context: Driver profile placeholder or review section.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Use kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='driver-accept-ride-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a hybrid fullstack app with a mobile-first Passenger/Driver interface and a dense Admin Dashboard.
Adhere STRICTLY to the Swiss Brutalist archetype: extreme contrast, 1px black borders, no soft shadows, hard geometrical edges.
Never use the default generic SaaS blue or Inter font. Use #FFBE00 (Signal Yellow) for primary CTAs.
For the Passenger and Driver maps, make the map view edge-to-edge (full viewport). Overlay interactive elements as floating 'Neo-Brutalist' cards (white bg, sharp black border, offset solid shadow).
Do not use Shadcn card components straight out of the box without applying the brutalist overrides (rounded-none, border-black).
For mobile flows, heavily rely on Shadcn's Drawer component acting as bottom sheets, styled flat and sharp.
